explanation: Merge of main into the documentation triage. From main: the App router uses navigation attempts with a replace/push/hold write policy, view setters start an attempt only on a real change, shell controls call supersede() before navigate, and the new route-landing module decides what a URL means. From this branch: docs keep decisions, invariants, provenance and procedure order and point to code; CONTEXT.md entries name the owner and its invariants. The merged CONTEXT.md keeps the trimmed form and carries main's router rules plus a new Route landing entry. PRODUCT, DESIGN, CHANGELOG, runbooks and records are as triaged.
